title: DDP refuses the nWo and battles Savage
summary: Diamond Dallas Page’s resistance to the nWo turns personal when Randy Savage targets him and Kimberly. Their rivalry moves Page from rising outsider to a credible main-event star.

chapters.title: Page scores the breakthrough victory
chapters.result: DDP defeats Savage in a no-disqualification match.
chapters.context: The Diamond Cutter supplies the biggest victory of Page’s career to that point.

chapters.title: Savage wins the Las Vegas Sudden Death match
chapters.result: Savage defeats DDP after outside interference.
chapters.context: The extended personal feud ends this chapter with Savage winning, while Page has become an established headliner.
